title: 87% Indians Seek Paranormal Travel Experiences While 93% Desire Mood-Based Holidays
excerpt: Booking.com’s Travel Predictions 2027 report reveals nine travel trends that will shape how Indians plan their holidays.
content:
As a traveller, I no longer book a stay just to explore places, and I don’t wait for the perfect occasion to plan trips. Today, people are planning their holidays based on their interests, moods and many other factors. Booking.com has released its Travel Predictions 2027 report, revealing nine trends that will shape travel in the coming year.

Which Trends Will Influence Travel In The Future?

1. Going Out Of Character

Travellers are moving beyond their comfort zones. According to the report, 89% of Indian travellers want to choose a holiday that lets them do something completely out of character. Meanwhile, 65% want to surprise their friends and family with their travel choices. Also, 45% have avoided sharing holiday pictures because their trips felt too ordinary.

2. Budget Comes First

Spending habits play an important role in travelling. 75% of Indian travellers have reconsidered inviting someone because of different spending habits. Further, 71% have faced disagreements over money during trips, while 61% have removed someone from a travel group. Interestingly, 74% of Indian parents also want child-free holidays so they can spend more on themselves.

3. Vibe-Check

For many travellers, the holiday mood matters more than the destination. Around 93% of Indians want to choose destinations based on how they want to feel. Also, 92% would use a search tool that suggests places based on their mood.

4. Only The Good Stuff!

Travellers are now more mindful of their health and food choices. Include me in this! For 92% of Indian travellers, health, body or lifestyle changes influence their travel decisions. Meanwhile, 71% want packages that let them remove services they will not use, and 85% would allow their diet to influence their accommodation or destination choices.

5. A Holiday Calls For A Little Spooky

The new travel trend is travellers growing interest in haunted places and paranormal. Around 87% of Indian travellers are interested in paranormal experiences. 80% want experiences that could help them connect with someone on the other side, while 77% are curious about activities that explore death, spirituality and the afterlife.

6. Rely On AI To Handle Work

AI could help travellers enjoy their holidays without worrying about work. Around 69% find the last day of their vacation less enjoyable because they think about returning to work. Further, 64% carry laptops to manage their inboxes. However, 86% are interested in letting AI handle their work. Around 66% would allow it to manage emails and admin, while the same percentage would use it to catch up on missed updates.

7. Rest Is Priority

Around 89% would take a long-haul flight if they could arrive feeling rested. Their preferences include sleep-friendly food and drinks (38%), skincare kits (25%), jet-lag-friendly lighting (20%) and quiet, child-free zones (16%).

8. From Sports To Friends

For 90% of Indian travellers, physical activities have helped them build lasting friendships. Further, 83% are interested in joining communities of like-minded people while travelling. Also, 78% of solo travellers interested in attending sporting or fitness events want to make new friends.

9. Opportunity To Resolve Disagreements

Travel is not only about exploring places but also about a great opportunity to resolve disputes. 71% of Indians take trips to work on conflicts. Also, 96% say at least one holiday activity helps them have honest or difficult conversations.
